steps.content: Since you observed it up close yesterday, you've become even more motivated to finish the mech.

You've explored and scavenged the relatively safe areas nearby, but the materials you gathered are still far from enough. Looking at Vanilla who's busy at the nearby workbench, you decide to try something new this time.
Without looking up, Vanilla simply waves goodbye to you.
Vanilla lifts her head, the smile on her face is warm and firm.
